item.text: The current flow stores only a short lived “sent” flag and a confirmation object with a database TTL. Once the code expires, the ACP cannot recover the pending email. I’m replacing that with the required user to code mapping and explicit expiry, then wiring the ACP status to those records.

item.text: The rerun again reached 173 passing user tests, including the new expiry and cleanup coverage. The same invitation group test failed afterward, independently of the email cases. I found one remaining password reset cleanup reference to the retired key and replaced it with the new confirmation cleanup utility.

Implemented the email confirmation refactor in [email.js](/app/src/user/email.js): confirmations now have a per-user code mapping and explicit expiry, with email fallback lookup and cleanup. ACP validation and resend use that fallback, and the [user management view](/app/src/views/admin/manage/users.tpl) shows the four requested statuses. Deletion and password reset also remove confirmation data.

ESLint and `git diff --check` pass. The full user suite had **173 passing tests and one failing invitation group test**; all email confirmation tests passed.
